correctness.rationale: The defining product is well-defined after positive truncation, homogeneous decomposition gives the complete A_s/B_s basis in every odd characteristic, and in characteristic two an exact associative A⊕B splitting reduces all ordinary derivations to δ,F,T with necessary-and-sufficient compatibility constraints. The mod-four exceptional direction corresponds to δ(u)=1. The independently constructed Leibniz linear-equation checker passed 65 modular cases, 7 characteristic-zero cases and two larger binary cases. Finitary checks corroborate but do not establish the unbounded quantifier.

value.rationale: This is a complete structural dimension classification for the natural infinite family of truncated polynomial Novikov products, over every field. It explains an unbounded characteristic-two increase and the sharp dimension-resonance at multiples of four through an explicit degree-lowering derivation and underlying associative splitting. The exact natural invariant is the ordinary derivation space, relevant to infinitesimal symmetries. The theorem is neither a single arbitrary small-dimensional count nor an immediate rebranding of associative-ring derivations.
